warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ with one vendor bid, as required for prepared-state cases.
Enable eRFX projects as required for the RFQ event.
Ensure counter-offer functionality is not hidden on RFQs.
Use the requested buyer bid-rejection configuration.
Enable buyer bid editing for the requested scenario.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case configuration.
Open the RFQ stage before inspecting its Responses view.
Navigate to the buyer's Responses tab where the Settings control is available.
Open the current event Settings menu and assert that every expected action is offered.
